mapper.select: SELECT o.orderID, o.goodID, o.buyerID, o.sellerID, o.amount, o.status, o.payTimeout, o.createTime, g.title AS goodTitle, ( SELECT p.pictureURL FROM picture p WHERE p.goodID = g.goodID ORDER BY p.pictureID DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS goodPictureURL FROM orders o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goodID = g.goodID WHERE o.buyerID = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.createTime DESC
